'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 3)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[The Legend of the Scarab]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]
*+1 [[Lore]]

The investigator that has '''Walter Gilman''' as an [[ally]] can't have more than one [[monster trophy]] at a time.

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
